name: Fate/Grand Order: Unofficial Story Port
source:
F/GO is an online RPG for the iOS and Android told in a Visual Novel Style. Referred to as the "Fate Online Project Reboot", it is a reboot of the original Fate/Apocrypha project that eventually became a novel series.

This is the unofficial fan-made PC port of the original game's story.
translation:
《Fate/Grand Order》（简称FGO）是一款登陆iOS与Android平台、采用视觉小说形式叙事的在线RPG。该作曾被称为“Fate Online Project Reboot”，是对最初企划后来转型为轻小说系列的《Fate/Apocrypha》项目的重启之作。

本作是由粉丝自制的非官方原版游戏剧情PC移植版。
